Title: Organization preview
Subtitle: Review dates, names and destinations before copying
RuleNote: Year / month folders · Copy to archive · Keep originals
Idle: Choose a source and an archive folder, then scan
CanceledSummary: Task canceled. Completed operations are retained.
PreviewNotice: Preview only reads files. Copying keeps the originals.
ChooseDirectories: Choose existing source and archive folders.
NestedDirectories: Source and archive folders must be separate, without nesting.
UnsafePath: Choose regular local folders. Links, online-only files and staging folders are skipped.
TargetDisk: The archive folder must be on a local NTFS drive.
Changed: The file or destination changed. Please scan again.
InvalidImage: Image format or metadata could not be verified. Skipped.
BusyDestination: Another instance is writing to this archive. Try again later.
CloseWhileBusy: Cancel the task and wait for file operations to finish before closing.
PermissionError: Some paths could not be accessed. Check file permissions.
HistoryNote: Select rows to preview undo, or verify and recover unfinished operations. Undoing copies moves them into the archive's withdrawn folder.
PendingWarning: {0} unfinished records found. Verify and recover them in history.
RenameNotice: Renaming changes the original file names. Review the preview first. Companion file groups are skipped.
RenameRuleNote: Rename within each folder · Undo available in history
ConfirmUndo: Undo {0} selected operations? Renamed files return to their original names. Archived copies move to the archive's withdrawn folder.
UndoPreviewNote: Review undo destinations and conflicts. Use Ctrl or Shift to choose rows, then select Undo selected.
ConfirmRecover: Check unfinished records and finish only operations with matching file identity and content and an available target. Uncertain entries remain for review.
ConfirmClear: Clearing history removes the corresponding automatic undo information. Export any records you need first. Photo files are retained.
ConfirmAbandon: Stop automatic recovery for selected records and preserve all originals, copies and staging files. Export history first if needed for manual review.
NotCommitted: This operation is not completed and cannot be undone
UndoOccupied: Original name or withdrawal path is occupied
MissingIdentity: Trusted file identity or recovery information is missing
NewerHistory: History was created by a newer app version. Open it with that version.
PendingHistory: Unfinished records remain. Recover them or stop their recovery first.
NoOutput: No output found. Originals are preserved.
PreservedFiles: Automatic recovery stopped. All files are preserved.
HistorySubtitle: Review completed operations, undo changes or recover unfinished tasks
TemporaryChanged: Temporary file identity changed or cleanup was blocked. Preserved for review.
